proof_body:
by
  intro a b c hab
  have hd : b - a ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr hab.symm
  have hn : (0:ℝ) < ‖b - a‖ ^ 2 := by positivity
  set u := (c - a) / (b - a) with hu
  have e : c - a = u * (b - a) := by rw [hu]; field_simp
  have h1 : inner ℝ (b - a) (c - a) = ‖b - a‖ ^ 2 * u.re := by
    have e' : u * (b - a) * (starRingEnd ℂ) (b - a) = ((‖b - a‖ ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) * u := by
      rw [mul_assoc, Complex.mul_conj', Complex.ofReal_pow, mul_comm]
    rw [Complex.inner, e, e', Complex.re_ofReal_mul]
  rw [h1]
  constructor
  · intro h
    exact (mul_eq_zero.mp h).resolve_left hn.ne'
  · intro h
    rw [h, mul_zero]
target_source: ∀ a b c : ℂ, a ≠ b → (inner ℝ (b - a) (c - a) = 0 ↔ ((c - a) / (b - a)).re = 0)
